page_title: NAN 0-1 PSG | Nantes v PSG 17/08/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+5' Johann Lepenant (Nantes) squanders a big chance! The ball rebounded out to him and he misdirects his shot well wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for PSG.
90+5' A cross from Hyun-Seok Hong (Nantes) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.

90+4' Ousmane Dembele (PSG) finds space inside the box to shoot after collecting a short pass, but it's a wasted effort as it flies well wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Nantes.
90+4' Johann Lepenant (Nantes) was too forceful with his tackle and Benoit Bastien interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
90+2' Dehmaine Assoumani (Nantes) hammers the ball from far out, but it goes narrowly over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for PSG.
90' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.

88' Bradley Barcola (PSG) receives a brilliant pass and wastes a big opportunity as his shot from inside the penalty area flies narrowly wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Nantes will have a goal kick.
86' Louis Leroux goes off the pitch and Dehmaine Assoumani (Nantes) comes on.
86' 0:4 - the latest stats for both teams in respect of shots on target.
84' Nicolas Cozza (Nantes) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.

82' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. PSG are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
80' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Achraf Hakimi (PSG) was quite harsh and Benoit Bastien didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
79' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Amady Camara (Nantes) will replace Mostafa Mohamed.
79' Here is a change. Hyeok-Kyu Kwon is going off and Luis Castro gives the last tactical orders to Francis Coquelin (Nantes).
78' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (PSG) is coming onto the pitch as Goncalo Ramos cannot continue after picking up an injury.
78' Here comes the VAR verdict. NO GOAL for PSG due to an offside in the build-up play.
78' The PSG players halt their celebrations as referee Benoit Bastien makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was an offside in the build-up play.
76' Goal - 0:2! Goncalo Ramos (PSG) gets a shot away from the edge of the box and scores into the bottom right corner. Vitinha provided an assist for the goal.
76' Nuno Mendes (PSG) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Anthony Lopes intercepts the ball.
74' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Nuno Mendes (PSG).

73' Chidozie Awaziem (Nantes) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent. It's a free kick to PSG, but they probably won't attempt a direct shot on goal from here.
70' The referee blows for a cooling break.
69' Ousmane Dembele (PSG) breaks past challenges inside the box, but puts too much pace on his pass to Achraf Hakimi. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Nantes.
67' 0 - 1 Vitinha (PSG) picks it up in space and from the edge of the box lashes in a shot that is deflected past the helpless Anthony Lopes. 0:1.
67' PSG take a short corner kick.

67' Achraf Hakimi (PSG) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it. PSG have been awarded a corner kick.
66' A lofted pass picks out Lucas Beraldo (PSG) in space in the box, he beats the keeper with a low drive but it's blocked on the line by a defender.
66' PSG work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
66' Goncalo Ramos (PSG) receives a sweet pass inside the box, but his effort on goal is blocked by the defender. The linesman points to the corner flag, PSG are going to take it.
65' Ousmane Dembele (PSG) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
65' Bradley Barcola (PSG) gets on the end of a pass on the edge of the box but his shot is blocked.

58' Bahereba Guirassy (Nantes) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.

56' Fabian Ruiz (PSG) receives a good pass and from just outside the box he unleashes a promising strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender. PSG force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
56' The PSG players are exchanging some short passes.
55' Anthony Lopes displays his ability to read the game and clears the danger after Fabian Ruiz (PSG) threatened to latch onto a through ball from just outside the box.
54' Good movement by Ibrahim Mbaye (PSG), but he can't find any of his teammates as the cross is poor. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Nantes.
53' Kang-In Lee (PSG) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
52' Wonderful pass from Ibrahim Mbaye (PSG) for Kang-In Lee, but they can't profit from it as Anthony Lopes comes off his line to collect.
50' The ball is cleared after Ibrahim Mbaye (PSG) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
50' Vitinha (PSG) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
49' Ibrahim Mbaye (PSG) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long. The ball goes out of play and Nantes will have a goal kick.
47' Yassine Benhattab (Nantes) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
46' Referee Benoit Bastien blows his whistle to start the second half.

45+2' Referee Benoit Bastien has finally had enough of Luis Castro and brandishes a yellow card at him!
45+1' Kelvin Amian (Nantes) earns the yellow card.
45' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
45' A sweeping move ends with a pass to Lucas Hernandez (PSG) inside the box. He lets fly towards the middle of the goal, but Anthony Lopes was watching it all the way and makes a comfortable save.
44' The current number of shots on goal is 0:2.
42' A loose pass is instantly latched onto by Goncalo Ramos (PSG). He tries his luck from the edge of the box with a measured shot, but it hits the crossbar and is cleared to safety.
42' Bradley Barcola (PSG) collects a pass and finds himself in a good position to strike from the edge of the box, but his attempt is blocked.
41' Vitinha (PSG) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
40' Some great play by Bradley Barcola (PSG) ends with a shot on the edge of the box low towards the middle of the net, but Anthony Lopes sees it all the way and makes a comfortable save.
39' Nantes quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
39' Bahereba Guirassy (Nantes) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence. Corner kick. Nantes will have an opportunity.
36' Bradley Barcola (PSG) sends a cross into the box, but Anthony Lopes comes off his line to gather the ball.
33' PSG keep possession of the ball by producing short passes and one-two passes from player to player.
31' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Nantes comes to nothing.
30' Mostafa Mohamed (Nantes) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Nantes.
27' It’s time for the cooling break for the players to take on some fluids. It’s hot out there!
23' A pass lands at the feet of Goncalo Ramos (PSG) in the middle of the box, he looks up and shoots but the effort is superbly blocked by a defender.

19' Kang-In Lee (PSG) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. The ball goes behind for a corner. PSG will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
17' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Nantes.
16' Kang-In Lee (PSG) swings in the corner, but it's comfortably cleared away.

15' Bradley Barcola (PSG) sends over a cross from the side into the penalty area in order to find one of his teammates, but he fails and the opportunity goes begging. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Nantes.
12' Kang-In Lee (PSG) puts a cross into the box from the corner but there is no panic from the opposition and they easily clear.
11' Vitinha (PSG) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
8' Yassine Benhattab (Nantes) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
5' Bradley Barcola (PSG) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
